I have 13.73 hectares in total but this barley plot is only small, 0.19 ha, here in Oromia. Barley grows well in our cooler highland area, and I always put some manure from my animals on it because I have livestock on my larger farm. I will try to get DAP and urea from the cooperative — barley needs some nitrogen but not as much as maize, and the fertilizer is expensive and often comes late. I keep my own barley seed from last harvest like my neighbors do, and we do not spray pesticides on barley here. The rain in meher season is enough, so no irrigation. Since the plot is small, my family can handle most of the work ourselves, but during weeding and harvest I may call a few hands to help.
